priceCovers._doc: What the initial fee covers, filled in by the scripts (lib/quote.js priceCovers). lines: the card's and the PDF's "Price covers" list; the script adds "Then $X a month, starting month 4" at the end. text: the pieces of the customer's text ("...$174, which covers <pieces joined: a, b and c> (details in the picture)"). details: the "How we fix it" paragraphs in the email and PDF. finePrint: under the fix in the email and PDF. An item with findings shows only for those findings (one quote can merge several) and goes to the top; exclusion true/false shows only on the price with/without exclusion; topFor moves it to the top for those findings.

lines.text: Every carpenter bee hole foamed, plus all outside wood treated to prevent new damage
Active nests treated and removed, plus an outside treatment that prevents new nests
First 3 treatments in 3 months, the first two 2 weeks apart

details.text: We foam every carpenter bee hole and treat the outside wood to prevent new ones.
We treat and remove every active nest, then treat the outside of your home to prevent new ones.
Your first 3 treatments come in the first 3 months, the first two 2 weeks apart. Signature covers 30+ pests inside and out, with free return visits between treatments.

lines.text: Entry points sealed with foam and copper mesh
Inspection, traps and stations set up
7 days of daily visits to remove animals

details.text: We seal the entry points around your foundation with foam, copper mesh and hardware cloth. We don't do construction repairs (foundation, siding or roofing).
We identify the animal, set traps and stations, and visit daily for 7 days to remove them. A follow-up visit at two weeks checks that they're gone.
We also apply a granular repellent, and you get free return visits for 3 months.

lines.text: Liquid soil treatment around the home
Bait stations installed around the home

text.text: the soil treatment and bait stations, with a damage warranty

details.text: We treat the soil directly where wood touches the ground.
We treat the termite activity directly with foam and a soil treatment.
Then we install bait stations around the house, about every 15 to 20 feet.

finePrint: The damage warranty covers new termite damage while your plan is active, not damage that's already there.
